resources.string:
Precision Without the Drain

 Most battery apps drain your power just to measure it. HeyBattery is different. We designed this app with a "Zero Drain" philosophy. We don't run heavy background services; we use smart mathematics.

 How our 4 main cards work:

 1. Time Since Charge
 • What it does: Shows exactly how long your phone has been running on battery.
 • The Logic: We don't run a timer in the background. When you unplug your phone (above 80%), we simply save that exact timestamp. When you open the app, we calculate the difference instantly. Zero battery cost.

 2. Deep Sleep Time
 • What it does: Tells you how long your phone's processor was fully "asleep" to save power while the screen was off.
 • The Logic: We read the system's internal "Birth Certificate" (Boot Timestamp). By comparing the total elapsed time versus the time the CPU was active, we calculate sleep duration mathematically without needing to monitor the phone constantly.
 Note: If this value is low or zero, it means another app is keeping your phone awake in the background.

 3. Remaining Time
 • What it does: Predicts when your battery will die.
 • The Logic: We use a "Hybrid Prediction Model". We combine your long-term usage history (40%) with your current session's drain rate (60%). This gives you a realistic estimate that adapts to what you are doing right now.

 4. Charging Info / Status
 • What it does: Displays real-time Volt, Watt, and Temperature data while charging.
 • The Logic: We read raw data directly from hardware sensors. To prevent overheating, this monitoring stops completely the moment you close the app or turn off the screen.

 100% Private. No Internet Required. No Background Notifications.
